mechanism: Both drugs cause hemolytic anemia through different mechanisms (primaquine via oxidative stress in G6PD-deficient patients; isotretinoin via bone marrow suppression and teratogenicity), with additive hematologic risk and overlapping hepatotoxicity concerns.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly; verify G6PD status before primaquine use; both drugs require careful hepatic monitoring and absolute contraindication in pregnancy due to isotretinoin's severe teratogenicity.
